summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around AI optical photonics chokepoints. The strongest underfollowed lane is upstream of transceiver brands: InP substrates, InP laser/detector capacity, photodiodes/TIAs, CW lasers, and alternative III-V-on-silicon manufacturing platforms. Lumentum is included as a reference capacity anchor for InP lasers/detectors. AXTI, MTSI, and ALMU are the discovery-lane candidates: AXTI maps most directly to scarce InP substrate supply; MTSI maps to 1.6T optical component chipsets including lasers, photodiodes and TIAs; ALMU is a small-cap/speculative platform candidate attempting to bypass native InP substrate constraints through large-diameter III-V-on-silicon manufacturing. Claims are intentionally separated: current product existence is treated as fact when supported by company or filing sources; chokepoint economics, customer pull-through, and qualification scarcity remain hypotheses for later verification.
